score: 1 false proof (1 open root cause, routed); 1058 correct proofs of 2005 pairs
metric: Seeded pairs from 27 rewrite templates, Sol's 24 S015 construct families and query mutants, over typed schemas with keys, NOT NULL columns and foreign keys, plus the 5 published S009 false proofs. Each pair runs on six legal DuckDB databases (random, NULL-heavy, duplicate-heavy, empty); a pair the prover proves while a database separates it is a false proof.
correctness: 1 false proof, 0 generator label errors (seed 2, count 2000). Every difference is confirmed with DuckDB's optimizer off. The open one is _collapse_aggregate folding COUNT over a one-row-per-group aggregate into the inner COUNT, listed in tests/fixtures/soundness_fuzz/known_false_proofs.json with its owner. Ground truth is six finite databases per pair, so a difference they all miss can still hide a false proof.
caveats: Pairs are generated, not drawn from a public benchmark, and the templates were written knowing the open audit families (S004-S014). Only queries inside a closed SQL subset where BigQuery and DuckDB agree are executed; 8 pairs were skipped. On master 6e86a4b the same fuzzer also found float-widening false proofs (fixed by #427) and LIMIT 0 tails dropped from INTERSECT, EXCEPT and same-source UNION DISTINCT (S006-001, fixed since). One pair exceeds the 20-second wall timeout because the prover's solver timeout does not bound the whole call.
